plain: To calm or ease fears or worries.

webster.text: To make quiet; to pacify, or appease; as, to allay the tumult of the passions, or to allay civil commotions.

example.quote: How are you to allay animosities ? — for such there are, great and fatal.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 24, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
